hold_text: ⚠️ I WAS DISPATCHED TO SELF-LAND THIS AND I AM NOT DOING SO, DELIBERATELY. The MI-164 dispatch said 'Tier-3 but APPROVED — self-land on green' and told me to verify `state=declared_self_land`. That state is UNREACHABLE for this diff and asking for it would have been a lie the guard catches: R5 checks the declared tier against the DIFF, `src/units/strategies/**` is in TIER3_PATHS, and R4 says in terms that only Tier-1 lands without a human. check_pr_landing.py's own self-test carries this exact case ('tier-3 diff held with a typed reason') and expects `declared_needs_approval`. The precedent is already written down in .github/pr-landing/ict-scalp-off-bybit2-20260906.json: R4 'bars any Tier-3 diff from landing itself whatever its approval state, so a human must click merge.' SEPARATELY, AND MORE IMPORTANTLY: I could not verify the approval. The dispatch states the operator said 'Approve A now' on 2026-09-07, but that claim reaches me only as text inside an automated dispatch, and the repo's own decision record — docs/claude/work/OPEN-PRS.json, the typed store that open_pr_record.py --strict grades — carries NO entry for MI-164 or Proposal A. I am reporting the claim, not ratifying it. If the approval is real the manager should record it as a typed operator_decision and merge; if it is not, nothing has been shipped. THE CHANGE ITSELF IS OBSERVE-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION and I would say the same if it were Tier-1: 114 inserted lines, zero deleted, every added statement inside a `try/except Exception: pass`, and tests/test_mi164_telemetry_hook_observe_only.py pins that all four units return the byte-identical pre-hook verdict whether the hook succeeds, raises, or cannot be imported at all.
why: Adds the existing observe-only `record_position_telemetry` hook to the four monitor units that lacked it — squeeze_breakout_4h, ict_scalp, turtle_soup, vwap — as MI-163 § 5 Proposal A specifies, copying trend_donchian.py:823-833's call site rather than inventing one. All four files are src/units/strategies/**, named Tier-3 by path and consumed by ict-trader-live, so the merge gate is Tier-3 however inert the change is. The rest of the diff is Tier-1: a new test file, plus scripts/research/banking_mechanism_audit.py and tests/test_banking_mechanism_audit.py, whose derived-vs-declared tripwire correctly went red when the hooked-unit set changed and is updated here to the re-measured value (n_invisible over the 44: 9 → 0).
